_README: Which run directories each AppWorld arm is built from.
Both `scripts/build_appworld_table.py` and `scripts/plot_appworld_curves.py` read this file, so
the two artifacts are always built from the same runs -- they used to carry separate hardcoded
copies of these globs, which could drift apart silently.
TO REPRODUCE WITH YOUR OWN RUNS: copy this file, replace each glob with your run directories,
and pass --runs-manifest yours.json to either script. Globs are resolved against --runs-root
(default: the repo root), and may name any directory under it -- they are not confined to
`runs/`. They must be RELATIVE: Path.glob refuses an absolute pattern, so put the prefix in
--runs-root instead. Pass --out (table) / --out-dir (curves) as well, or the artifacts built
from your runs overwrite the committed ones.
Each glob must match one or more attempt-bearing run directories. The official ReAct baseline
has no entry here and needs none: its artifacts live outside the repo, under AppWorld's own data
root, so the scripts give it an empty manifest key and read it from --official-root instead.
